description: This line plot illustrates how the reliability score of different ensemble models of Large Language Models (LLMs) changes with increasing cost. The x-axis represents “Cost,” ranging from 0 to 10, with tick marks at intervals of 2, and is labeled as linear. The y-axis represents “Reliability Score,” ranging from 30 to 90, with major gridlines at intervals of 10. Three distinct lines are plotted: the “3-Model Ensemble,” shown as a solid blue line with circular markers, starts at a reliability score of approximately 82 when the cost is 0 and decreases to about 74 at a cost of 10; the “2-Model Ensemble,” shown as a solid red line with circular markers, begins at a reliability score of approximately 85 when the cost is 0 and declines to about 73 at a cost of 10; and the “3-Model Ensemble” also includes a yellow line with circular markers that starts at a reliability score of 90 when the cost is 0 and sharply declines to approximately 40 at a cost of 10. All three lines show a general downward trend as cost increases.
